decisions.reason: As a 2024 launch close to the core water-control offer, the flap weir still has option value and likely low incremental carrying cost, but its limited web prominence suggests weaker early traction than the firm's stronger bets.

The energy management system fits the firm's strategic move toward digitally networked, efficient infrastructure, so with uncertainty still unresolved its upside appears to outweigh the cost of keeping it on the market.

The overflow flap gate is tightly aligned with the established business and was given a dedicated product page, which indicates stronger commitment or demand and therefore a lower likelihood of withdrawal.
